title: Fixed Slotted Cradle and Raised Wire Frame Egg Slicer
description: One newly authored complete fixed hinged-wire egg-slicer-style exterior. A single low continuous base contains a shallow oval-profile concave cradle and nine genuine long through slots, with intact peripheral material. Two rear hinge pedestals retain one transverse axis. One full raised perimeter frame holds nine finite blunt parallel wire-shaped members spanning its opposite ends; a whole front finger pad and four low feet complete the object. The relation is a low slotted shaped cradle under a hinged open frame, not the old tall bread blade bank or deep garlic cup and pressure block. All geometry original, three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Empty static kitchen-tool appearance only: no egg, blade sharpness, wire tension, cutting, hinge motion, food handling, hygiene, ergonomic or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
